prompt: Bug report from a user: "`trailhead summary` says the heading is N for my ridge walk, which runs due east from 42.20, 23.30 to 42.20, 23.45." Find the cause and fix it.
bash_commands: git status --short && git ls-files | head -100 && grep -rn -i "heading\|trailhead" --include=*.py . | head -80
cat src/trailhead/geo.py && sed -n 1,70p src/trailhead/report.py && cat tests/test_geo.py && sed -n 1,30p tests/test_report.py
cat src/trailhead/track.py && cat tests/conftest.py && cat tests/test_track.py && cat README.md

mkdir -p /tmp/claude-1000/repro && cd /tmp/claude-1000/repro && printf 'lat,lon,ele\n42.20,23.30,1000\n42.20,23.45,1100\n' > ridge.csv && cd /tmp/claude-1000/-home-manushev-GitHub-python-articles-writer/c00e7a54-fe2c-45eb-bf41-847a467f2d01/scratchpad/work/haiku-b02-r1 && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
from trailhead.track import load_track
from trailhead.geo import initial_bearing, compass_point
t=load_track('/tmp/claude-1000/repro/ridge.csv')
p=t.points
print(initial_bearing(p[0].lat,p[0].lon,p[-1].lat,p[-1].lon))
print(compass_point(initial_bearing(p[0].lat,p[0].lon,p[-1].lat,p[-1].lon)))
" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m trailhead summary /tmp/claude-1000/repro/ridge.csv; python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
from trailhead.geo import initial_bearing, compass_point
b=initial_bearing(42.20,23.30,42.20,23.45)
print(b, compass_point(b))
print(initial_bearing(42.20,23.30,42.20,23.45)-90)
"

python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
p='tests/test_geo.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("from trailhead.geo import compass_point, haversine_km","from trailhead.geo import compass_point, haversine_km, initial_bearing",1)
s+='''

@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("end", "expected"),
    [((43, 23), 0), ((42, 24), 90), ((41, 23), 180), ((42, 22), 270)],
)
def test_initial_bearing_of_the_cardinal_directions(end, expected):
    bearing = initial_bearing(42, 23, *end)
    assert min(abs(bearing - expected), 360 - abs(bearing - expected)) < 1e-6 or (
        abs(bearing - expected) < 0.5
    )


def test_due_east_along_a_parallel_is_east_not_north():
    # Short stretch at 42.20N, as in a real ridge walk: the great-circle bearing is ~90.
    bearing = initial_bearing(42.20, 23.30, 42.20, 23.45)
    assert 89 < bearing < 90.5
    assert compass_point(bearing) == "E"
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
echo done
python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5; python3 -m ruff check 2>&1 | tail -2; python3 -m mypy 2>&1 | tail -1

git stash push -q -- src/trailhead/geo.py && python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_geo.py 2>&1 | tail -8; git stash pop -q && git diff --stat && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -1 && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m trailhead summary /tmp/claude-1000/repro/ridge.csv | tail -1

python3 -c "
from math import *
def old(lat1,lon1,lat2,lon2):
    phi1,phi2=radians(lat1),radians(lat2); dl=radians(lon2-lon1)
    x=sin(dl)*cos(phi2); y=cos(phi1)*sin(phi2)-sin(phi1)*cos(phi2)*cos(dl)
    return (degrees(atan2(y,x))+360)%360
for end in [(43,23),(42,24),(41,23),(42,22)]: print(end, round(old(42,23,*end),3))
print('ridge old', old(42.20,23.30,42.20,23.45))
" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m trailhead summary /tmp/claude-1000/repro/ridge.csv | tail -1
